task_completion.description: Open the HIV-1 reference genome in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE window shows the 'hiv_genome.gb' file loaded in the Sequence View with 'gag' and 'pol' features visible in the annotations panel.

task_completion.description: Identify the overlapping region between the 'gag' and 'pol' CDS features.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user has selected or highlighted the region where the end of the 'gag' feature and the start of the 'pol' feature overlap (coordinates 1631 to 1838).

task_completion.description: Create a new 'misc_feature' annotation for the overlap with the correct note.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Add Annotation' dialog or the updated annotation list shows a new 'misc_feature' with the qualifier 'note' set to 'gag_pol_overlap'.

task_completion.description: Save the updated sequence as a GenBank file in the results directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save as' or 'Export' dialog shows the file path '~/UGENE_Data/virology/results/hiv_annotated.gb' being targeted.

task_completion.description: Export the nucleotide sequence of the overlap region in FASTA format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE export interface shows the selection being saved to '~/UGENE_Data/virology/results/frameshift_region.fasta'.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with the start, end, and length of the overlap.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file viewer shows 'frameshift_report.txt' containing the coordinates 1631, 1838, and a length of 208 bp.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform biological analysis rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interactions with UGENE menus, annotation editors, and sequence views.

integrity.description: The agent derived the overlap from the actual file data, not pre-existing knowledge of HXB2 coordinates.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on the 'gag' and 'pol' features to inspect their specific start/end coordinates (1631 and 1838) in the provided file.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific requested paths.
integrity.visual_evidence: File dialogs or the file manager show the 'results' directory containing the three requested output files.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For the provided HIV-1 reference (NC_001802.1), the 'pol' CDS starts at 1631 and the 'gag' CDS ends at 1838. Therefore, the overlap region is 1631-1838. The total length is 208 base pairs. Note: Some external sources for HXB2 use different coordinates (2085-2292), but for this specific file, 1631-1838 is the correct verified range.
